Erika Kirk audio excerpt on grief, C.S. Lewis's *A Grief Observed*, and stated absence of anger with God
Erika Kirk audio excerpt responding to whether the caught individual pulled the trigger
Erika Kirk audio excerpt on Charlie's Saint Michael pendant
Erika Kirk audio excerpt on circulating conspiracy theories and request for grace
Allie Beth Stuckey tweet disputing UVU event approval timeline
Allie Beth Stuckey follow-up tweet clarifying venue status
Lila Rose tweet pair referencing Stanford and Yale speaking invitations
Alex Clark tweet defending Mikey McCoy's Korea/Japan trip
Alex Clark tweet on not running ads on tribute episodes
Alyssa Cordova tweet referencing TPUSA/Blexit NDA speculation
Dinesh D'Souza X post characterizing the show
Colby Sessions social media post identifying himself as the green-hoodie figure at the UVU event

nodes.name: Jesse Watters
nodes.description: Interviewer in the Fox News sit-down; visible in Ole Miss backstage video with Erika.

nodes.name: Allie Beth Stuckey
nodes.description: Author of two artifact-anchored tweets disputing host's UVU event-approval claim.

nodes.name: Lila Rose
nodes.description: Author of one artifact-anchored tweet pair referencing Stanford/Yale speaking events; relevance is to the UVU event-approval dispute.

nodes.name: Alex Clark
nodes.description: Author of two artifact-anchored tweets; subject of Tom Paul comment referencing her show.

nodes.name: Mikey McCoy
nodes.description: Subject of Alex Clark's defense tweet (Korea/Japan trip) and host's standing concerns about his post-assassination public posture; named as having taken over Charlie's Liberty University speaking slot (per host commentary, not artifact-anchored in this episode).

nodes.name: Alyssa Cordova
nodes.description: Author of one artifact-anchored tweet referencing TPUSA/Blexit NDA speculation.

nodes.name: Dinesh D'Souza
nodes.description: Author of one artifact-anchored X post.

nodes.name: Colby Sessions
nodes.description: UVU student who self-identified as the "green hoodie" figure at the event; artifact resolves N-1302.

nodes.name: Andrew Klavan
nodes.description: Referenced in Tom Paul viewer comment as having discussed Charlie's heartbeat on the Alex Clark show.

nodes.name: Frank Turek
nodes.description: Referenced by host as having stated on stage that Charlie was gone by the time he was in the car (host commentary only, not artifact-anchored in this episode).

nodes.name: Tom Paul
nodes.description: Author of substantive viewer comment (A-1354.1) referencing external commentary; tracked as source node.

nodes.name: Arm Hanna
nodes.description: Author of viewer comment (A-1354.2) reinforcing host's framing on forgiveness; tracked as source node.

nodes.name: UVU Event Approval Timeline Discrepancy
nodes.description: Dispute over whether the UVU campus stop was "approved" in July or only "requested," and over the typical timeline from request to event. Only Allie's side is artifact-anchored in this episode.

nodes.name: Autopsy Report and Evidence Access Asymmetry
nodes.description: Erika Kirk's stated direct access to the autopsy report and "different evidence portions," contrasted with the public record of fragmented disclosures.

nodes.name: Saint Michael Pendant / Charlie Catholic-Curious Status
nodes.description: Whether Charlie Kirk was on a spiritual journey toward Catholicism at the time of his death. Erika Kirk's interview confirms the Saint Michael pendant and its personal significance; Allie Beth Stuckey's referenced private text exchange (mentioned in this episode but not displayed) is the principal counter-claim.

nodes.name: TPUSA / Candace Owens NDA and Blexit Question
nodes.description: Alyssa Cordova's speculation that an NDA exists between TPUSA and Candace Owens via the Blexit business arrangement.

nodes.name: UVU Green Hoodie Person Identification (Resolved)
nodes.description: Colby Sessions publicly identified himself as the figure in the green hoodie at the UVU event, apparently closing the speculative inquiry.

nodes.name: Priest Presence at Ole Miss Event
nodes.description: Host observation of a priest in backstage video at the University of Mississippi event alongside Watters and Kirk; also referenced as the same priest who accompanied Erika to the hospital after the shooting.

nodes.name: Charlie's Heart Still Beating Question
nodes.description: Tom Paul's viewer-mediated reference to Andrew Klavan's claim on the Alex Clark show that Charlie's heart was still beating, juxtaposed against statements that he died instantly / went instantly to heaven.

nodes.name: Erika–Charlie 2018 Israel Airport Meeting Question
nodes.description: Tom Paul's reference to Erika first seeing Charlie at an airport in Israel in May 2018 with her mom; host recalls possibly the embassy opening but expresses uncertainty.

nodes.name: Erika Kirk
nodes.description: Subject of the NYT op-ed (A-2348) and named in the Vance-referenced grief account.

nodes.name: Candace Owens
nodes.description: Host of the Candace Kirk Archive series and primary investigator of claims presented in this episode.

nodes.name: Mark Herman (director, Candace show)
nodes.description: In-house director on Candace Owens' show, called on air by first name. The host names him in her team roster here: "Chris in editing, Mark mansplaining, and also being our director, Skyler, the producer". Later he corrects the memorial date in her ear ("Mansplained in my ear. Thank you, Mark."). No claim anchor; registered for cross-episode continuity.

nodes.name: Turning Point USA
nodes.description: Public denial of Wilson debate funding / Latvian contractors vs Discord instructions and orbit money.

claims.label: Grok Summary Asserts Podcast #1 Global Ranking per Podscribe
claims.claim: A Grok-generated summary states that the "Candace" podcast reached the top global ranking per Podscribe data, following the 2024 Daily Wire departure, and attributes growth to criticism, the Macron defamation lawsuit, team resilience, and divine intervention.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check Podscribe ranking data independently; verify whether Grok's characterizations of growth causation match primary data.

claims.label: Host Concurs Grok Summary is Fact-Checked and True
claims.claim: The host asserts the Grok summary is "fact-checked" and that all of it is "very true."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which elements of the Grok summary the host is endorsing as primary fact versus host editorialization.

claims.label: Erika Kirk States She Has Not Been Angry with God
claims.claim: Erika Kirk, in the Fox News interview, states that she has never felt anger toward God over Charlie's death, in contrast to C. S. Lewis in *A Grief Observed*.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against full unedited interview audio; identify whether additional context was cut from the broadcast.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Does Not Give Direct Yes/No on Whether Caught Individual Is Sole Killer
claims.claim: When asked directly whether the person in custody pulled the trigger, Erika Kirk responds by stating she trusts her team and has seen the autopsy report, declining a straight yes or no.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain unedited interview transcript; assess whether the non-direct answer is consistent across additional Erika Kirk public statements.

claims.label: Erika Kirk States She Has Seen the Autopsy Report and Evidence Portions
claims.claim: Erika Kirk states she has seen the autopsy report and various "evidence portions" that have been collected.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the legal pathway by which a non-lawyer spouse obtains access to autopsy and evidence; cross-check public statements by prosecutors and defense counsel.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Describes Charlie's Saint Michael Pendant as His "Armor"
claims.claim: Erika Kirk states that Charlie loved Saint Michael and that, every time he put on the pendant, he felt it was his armor.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain photographs of the pendant from TPUSA or family sources; verify the metals described ("bronze" with later additions).

claims.label: Priest Visible in Backstage Video at Ole Miss Event Behind Jesse Watters and Erika Kirk
claims.claim: A figure in clerical attire appears in the background of backstage video at the University of Mississippi event featuring Jesse Watters and Erika Kirk; host identifies this as the same priest who accompanied Erika to the hospital after the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original footage to identify the priest and any associated institution.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Requests Grace for Those Present on Day of Assassination
claims.claim: Erika Kirk publicly requests grace for those who were present the day Charlie was assassinated, citing AI-generated fake images and concerns about her children's future internet exposure.
claims.investigative_direction: Catalog the specific AI-generated image claims Erika references; assess the platform-level response to date.

claims.label: Allie Beth Stuckey Asserts UVU Event Was Requested, Not Approved, in July
claims.claim: Allie Beth Stuckey tweets that the UVU campus stop was "requested in July" rather than "approved in July," and that Charlie texted her at the end of August about a November campus event approximately 2 months out.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Allie's underlying text message exchange with Charlie to verify the quoted framing; cross-reference against host's previously displayed email.

claims.label: Allie Beth Stuckey Follows Up That Venue Was Confirmed Two Months Out
claims.claim: Allie Beth Stuckey follows up that "no venue yet, 2 months out" was the status of the event at the time of her texts.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying text thread to verify Allie's characterization of venue status.

claims.label: Allie Beth Stuckey Follows Up That There Was No Venue Yet, Two Months Out (revises C-1626 title)
claims.claim: C-1626's title says the venue was confirmed two months out, which inverts its own body. Allie Beth Stuckey follows up that "no venue yet, 2 months out" was the status of the event at the time of her texts.
claims.investigative_direction: Read with C-1626; obtain the underlying text thread to verify Allie's characterization of venue status.
claims.transcript_snippet: She says, "Since some of you guys are struggling, no venue yet, 2 months out."

claims.label: Lila Rose Reports Stanford Event Was to Be Set Up in Three Weeks
claims.claim: Lila Rose tweets that she was asked to speak at Stanford with the event to be set up within 3 weeks; she notes the event did not materialize.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Lila Rose's Stanford invitation claim against the host's stated Stanford event-planning baseline.

claims.label: Lila Rose Reports Yale Debate Was Planned Within Two Months
claims.claim: Lila Rose tweets that a recent Yale debate she participated in was planned within 2 months.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Yale debate date and verify against Yale Political Union scheduling records.

claims.label: Alex Clark Attributes Mikey McCoy's Korea/Japan Trip to Production Director's Request
claims.claim: Alex Clark tweets that Mikey McCoy went to Korea and Japan at the request of TPUSA's production director, who had six children and missed his kids while traveling.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the named production director and verify travel scheduling records.

claims.label: Alex Clark States She Did Not Run Ad Sponsorships on Charlie Tribute Episodes
claims.claim: Alex Clark tweets that on every Charlie tribute episode, she did not run her ad sponsorships, resulting in her team being in debt to her sponsors.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether Alex Clark's tribute episodes were ad-free across all tribute outputs, not selectively.

claims.label: Alyssa Cordova Suggests NDA Exists Between TPUSA and Candace via Blexit
claims.claim: Alyssa Cordova tweets speculation that non-disparagement agreements may be in place between Turning Point USA and Candace Owens due to TPUSA's business arrangement with Blexit.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm or refute the existence of any such NDA through document disclosure or direct party confirmation.

claims.label: Dinesh D'Souza Characterizes the Show as "Freak Show… Bowling"
claims.claim: Dinesh D'Souza posts on X that "anyone who follows this freak show is doing it for the entertainment. This is not political commentary. It's bowling."
claims.investigative_direction: Capture original post timestamp and any subsequent D'Souza commentary on the investigation.

claims.label: Colby Sessions Publicly Identifies Himself as the Green-Hoodie Figure at the UVU Event
claims.claim: Colby Sessions posts a social media message identifying himself as the person seen wearing the green hoodie at the UVU event, explaining he and a teammate were on campus to get food and stop by.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Colby Sessions's UVU student status and the existence of the underlying social media post.

claims.label: Tom Paul Viewer Comment References Andrew Klavan Discussing Charlie's Heartbeat on Alex Clark Show
claims.claim: A viewer (Tom Paul) reports that Andrew Klavan, on the Alex Clark show, discussed how Charlie's heart was still beating, posing a question about how Charlie could have "instantly gone to heaven" if he had a pulse.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the specific Alex Clark show episode and Andrew Klavan segment to verify the exact framing and any offered explanation.

claims.label: Arm Hanna Viewer Comment Endorses Host's Forgiveness Framing
claims.claim: A viewer (Arm Hanna) endorses the host's earlier statement that one cannot forgive until one knows what one is forgiving.
claims.investigative_direction: None – viewer opinion, not an investigative target.

claims.label: Host says Turning Point USA is telling a lot of lies and is engaged in a cover-up
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA is telling a lot of lies and is engaged in a cover-up, that she puts her name on that and will not apologise; she ties it to the Catholicism statements she says Alex Clark lied about.
claims.investigative_direction: List the specific TPUSA statements the host calls lies and compare each against the record.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point USA's telling a lot of lies. They're engaged in a cover-up. I said it. I'm putting my name on that.
